note: BAC Costa Rica's credit card tariff (in force from 3 July 2026): the Tarjeta de Crédito Óptima's total annual interest rate is 24.00% in colones, and BAC charges no account administration or membership fee on its cards.

sources.title: BAC Costa Rica, Tarifario de Tarjetas de Crédito (in force from 3 July 2026)
sources.said: Vigente a partir del 03 de julio del 2026 ... Tasa de interés total anual Producto Colones Dólares ... Tarjeta de Crédito Óptima 24,00% 24,00% ... Administración de Cta/Membresías $0
